correctness.rationale: Complete proof for all n>=3 from known cycle homotopy concentration, signed augmented Hopf trace, orbit-quotient graphs, exact recurrences, character determination and rational quotient averaging. Two standalone programs test 414 fixed-face traces for 3<=n<=20 and augmented boundary-space homology traces for 3<=n<=12. Boundary, both reflection classes and orbit degeneracies are accounted for. Finite tests are supporting checks, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The full D_n representation and its invariant quotient rational homology are not implied by the inspected nonequivariant cycle sphere-wedge theorem or the known Z2 equivariant restrictions. The very close Babson--Kozlov and Zivaljevic results are expressly acknowledged as strong partial prior coverage; no first-discovery or absolute-priority claim is made.
residual_risks: Published bibliographic search coverage is not exhaustive; an equivalent dihedral character or quotient computation may exist in unindexed literature.
Known Z2-equivariant results already cover odd-cycle reflection information (Babson--Kozlov) and n=6p-1 (Zivaljevic), so no novelty is attributed to those restrictions.
The result is rational only; the quotient may have additional integral torsion not studied here.

value.rationale: For this classical infinite family, complete intrinsic symmetry representations distinguish two-dimensional rationally irreducible topology from four one-dimensional character types. The sharp n mod 12 criterion for rational homology survival under full dihedral quotient gives a mathematically natural complete classification not visible from ordinary Betti numbers, without requiring an unrelated downstream theorem.
